scope: durable installer with isolated fixture agents
checks: declined adoption leaves the legacy agent and its shell running; nothing is registered or recorded
confirmed adoption ends legacy sessions, unregisters the legacy agent, registers guardian then gateway and records the verified incarnation; no shell is adopted

signed gateway update: the running gateway validates the staged candidate under the admission barrier and hands over; the installer swaps the bundle and re-registers; the new gateway verifies itself and resumes admission; guardian, workspace and shell are unchanged
guardian maintenance is refused while sessions live unless confirmed; confirmed maintenance ends them, restarts the guardian with a new incarnation and records it
after a guardian restart the installer reports ended sessions with the old and new incarnations, never restoration, and then reports the new guardian as running
uninstall ends confirmed sessions, removes both durable agents and the record, and does not reinstate the legacy agent
